source_snapshot.procedure: Boot BMC into U-Boot and run dramtest 0 for over 12 hours.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; manual BMC bootloader DRAM cold/high-rail test.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY; requires vendor command semantics, console evidence, dew-point controls and service recovery.

old_problem: Vendor-specific dramtest 0 range and return semantics were not supplied, but can be a mandatory pre-execution authorization without leaving the review itself unresolved.
disposition_reason: ED-03 permits a BMC standard draft but forbids guessed OEM semantics. The case is review-resolved only as a vendor-gated manual procedure: execution remains prohibited until the exact BMC/U-Boot help/spec, safe memory range and recovery are approved; ED-14 preserves over 12 hours.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row42 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3079 and actual next row43/history3080 were read.
Literal dramtest 0 is retained but never interpreted generically; its platform implementation, reserved-memory safety, looping/progress and return behavior are an authorization gate.
Continuous console evidence must distinguish progress, completion, UART loss and BMC hang.
Production firmware/network/sensor service recovery plus dry warm-up is mandatory; no action ran.

test_case.test_name: BMC U-Boot dramtest 0 for over 12 hours at 0C/+5% rails
test_case.purpose: Verify BMC-local DRAM under the approved vendor implementation for over 12 hours at cold/high-rail margin and prove full return to normal BMC services.
required_package: Vendor help/spec for dramtest 0 range/destructive/loop semantics
Cold/high-rail limits and uninterrupted console oracle
Boot-state preservation and production-service recovery plan
test_case.test_command: Only after BMC owner authorization, qualified staff enter the approved U-Boot build, run the exact documented `dramtest 0` for more than 12 hours under dry 0C/+5% conditions with continuous console capture, then exit/reset by the approved path, warm dry and verify all BMC services.
test_case.expected_result: The authorized memory range completes the required interval with documented progress and no memory error/hang, then firmware boot, network, Redfish/IPMI, sensors and logs recover normally.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the exact approved implementation/range, uninterrupted >12-hour evidence and service recovery. A guessed command, silent console or reboot alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: Vendor/BMC-owner authorization of command and range
Preserve boot variables/logs and maintain independent recovery
Abort on memory error, console loss, moisture, electrical or thermal limit
No auto-retry; dry warm-up before access
expected_evidence: Preserved boot state and console route
Exit/reset, service recovery and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Use only the approved exit/reset/recovery path, preserve the transcript, return rails nominal, warm/dry safely, restore boot state and verify management services; quarantine on failed recovery.
